primary_estimands.meaning: Quadratic projection contrast at BMI35 minus twice BMI30 plus BMI25, conditional on other covariates; not proof of a full biological curve

cells.sparse: flag n<30 without merging or dropping

weighted_fit: Positive provided design weights normalized by their mean; WLS via weighted least squares; same point estimator for real and generated values
missingness: Eligibility fixed by preparation; no endpoint-specific outcome imputation, winsorization or favorable-case removal

reporting.direction: Point-direction agreement for estimable primary contrasts, reported with magnitudes; do not count positive means as sign success
reporting.magnitude: Difference in the endpoint's scientific units; no universal mixed-unit score or posthoc tolerance
reporting.conclusion: No supported/absent-effect or equivalence category without an appropriate reference inference procedure and prespecified substantive criterion
reporting.synthetic_uncertainty: No ordinary synthetic-data standard error interpreted as evidence uncertainty; residual ranges labelled Monte Carlo only
reporting.nonestimable: Retain every planned endpoint and construction failure
reporting.multiplicity: Descriptive screen, no confirmatory binary superiority claim; primary family fixed before generation

source_overlap_classification: Must be independently assigned per endpoint after packet admission and before generation: supplied / algebraic consequence / unprovided target analysis / assumption-dependent
release_gates: source packet independently admitted and hashed
all arms and construction/draw schedule fixed
evaluation code and inference scope fixed
boundaries: Evaluation-only; builder receives scientific use brief, not this exact endpoint list or hidden answers. Procedural Agent separation, generator sandbox only. No guarantee against pretraining knowledge.
reference_inference: NHANES full-design domain Taylor inference planned using positive fasting weights, strata andPSU; adapter must be reviewed and frozen before any reference outcome analysis. Current point module alone does not implement this.

derived_use.name: HOMA1_IR
derived_use.status: derived use demonstration, not additional independent truth
derived_use.algebraic_caveat: Under log-linear analyses adjusting log glucose, several HOMA1 associations are algebraic re-expressions of insulin associations; do not count twice
